name: Rezo 1.5.4
body:
Rezo privacy browser v1.5.4

- Auto-decline cookie consent banners
- Blocks only tracking domains (Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, etc.)
- Allows access to all websites
- Clears cookies on exit
- Version shown in window title
- cineb.cx trusted domain
- Silent updater runs once on first launch
- Auto-updates via MSIX (no admin)
